title: An n-dimensional subspace of ℝ^P is the span of an orthonormal n-frame
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let V ⊆ ℝ^P (Euclid P) be a linear subspace with dim V = n. Then there is an orthonormal family v = (v_0, …, v_{n−1}) in ℝ^P, indexed by Fin n, with span{v_0, …, v_{n−1}} = V.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → ∃ v : Fin n → Euclid P, Orthonormal ℝ v ∧ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) = V
